title: Make mailbox finalization and notification-state contracts explicit in types
outcome: Round-4 review found two Low-level sharp edges after the immutable dispatch-outcome split: MailboxAppendResult implements Deref to MailboxAppendReceipt, which hides the attached RAII finalization obligation at some call sites, and the frontend exposes notificationState as an unconstrained string despite a documented four-value domain. Refine the APIs without weakening the guard's drop fallback or compatibility decoding.
acceptance: Rust call sites cannot accidentally obscure or discard the finalization obligation; TypeScript notificationState uses the documented durableButNotWoken/queuedBehindActiveTurn/deliveredToIdleSession/recoveredWake domain; tests pin compatibility and guard release behavior.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
